phase_name: Authority Evaluation Production Wiring Independent Verification
summary: Closes AESIC-O-01: decision_session.build_application_context (the sole production SessionApplicationService composition site) now constructs a real AuthorityEvaluationService/FilesystemAuthorityRegistry/AuthorityEvaluationRecordStore via new pcae.aesic.composition, enabled automatically when at least one Decision Template is deployed under .pcae/authority-evaluation/templates/ (absent/empty/malformed stays disabled, byte-for-byte unchanged behavior -- AESIC-REQ-109). decision-session confirm now invokes Stage 1 (advisory-only, never gates on failure -- AESIC-REQ-091); decision-session readiness's pre-existing Stage 2 wiring (Phase 147M, previously dead code) is now reachable, persisting a real AER and canonical pointer. Repaired a latent gap discovered via this phase's own end-to-end CLI reproduction: publication_handoff_schema.py's to_payload/from_payload never serialized authority_evaluation_ref/citation_text (dead fields until this phase, since nothing before it ever populated them in production), fixed additively (new keys included only when non-None) so every pre-existing on-disk package's digest is unaffected -- regression-tested. governance-record publish now populates CHGR authority_basis_claimed from a real, current-effective Stage 2 citation end-to-end, verified via direct CLI reproduction through create -> evidence -> select -> preview -> confirm -> readiness -> governance-record publish, both with Authority Evaluation configured (citation populated) and without (field correctly absent, legacy behavior unchanged). Added pcae aesic status [--package-id] read-only diagnostics (reuses pre-existing, previously never-wired pcae.aesic.diagnostics.summarize_package from Phase 147M/147N rather than duplicating query logic). .pcae/policy.toml: added aesic to the commands zone's allowed dependencies, one narrowly-scoped, documented, additive edge. AESIC-N-01 (canonical-pointer cross-key confusion, Major, disclosed by 147N/147O) reviewed for reachability and confirmed not expanded: read_canonical remains single-argument-keyed everywhere it is called in production, including this phase's own new diagnostics caller -- verified by signature introspection and source-level absence of any write_pointer/write_record call from the new composition/diagnostics modules; repair remains out of this phase's authorized scope, deferred to a separately authorized follow-up. Runtime capability unaffected throughout (Observed / observe / unavailable, verified before and after). PublicationCoordinator verified (AST-based test) to import nothing from pcae.aesic/pcae.authority_evaluation -- construction/evaluation/persistence boundary preserved exactly as AESIC-REQ-025/026 require. 27 new tests across composition, production reachability, backward compatibility, non-gating, failure semantics, diagnostics, and AESIC-N-01 containment. Overall Verdict: AUTHORITY EVALUATION PRODUCTION WIRING IMPLEMENTED WITH NON-BLOCKING FINDINGS (the publication-handoff serialization repair, disclosed as an in-scope finding rather than silent scope creep; docs/COMMANDS.md staleness for the new command, consistent with a pre-existing, disclosed gap around 'pcae authority' never having been added either).
